description: Land Title Settlement Department - Urapola, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320600 (23/1200170)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act.
